requirement.title: LIVE terminal source
requirement.description: Detail panel default mode captures the selected pane's terminal content via tmux capture-pane -e -p every 1 second (hardcoded interval). Only the selected pane is captured (not all panes). Content auto-scrolls to bottom (latest visible). ANSI escape sequences from -e flag are parsed into Ink colored Text components using ansi-sequence-parser or equivalent.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given session arcforge:1.1 is selected and in LIVE mode, when 1 second elapses, then capture-pane -e -p -t arcforge:1.1 is called and the result replaces the detail content.
Given new capture content arrives, when the detail panel renders, then the view is scrolled to the bottom (latest content visible).

Given the captured content contains ANSI escape sequences (colors, bold, dim), when the detail panel renders in LIVE mode, then the sequences are parsed and rendered as colored Ink Text components (not displayed as raw escape codes, not stripped).
Given user switches selected session from arcforge:1.1 to workspace:1.1, when the selection changes, then the old capture timer is cleared and a new timer starts for workspace:1.1.
Given capture-pane fails (pane gone, tmux error), when the timer fires, then the error is handled gracefully — auto-fallback to CONV mode with "session ended" indicator (see fr-detail-004).

requirement.title: CONV conversation source
requirement.description: Tab toggles the detail panel to CONV mode, showing JSONL conversation preview via the existing readConversation logic. Refreshes every poll cycle (~3s). Shows structured "You: / AI:" conversation entries. Persists when pane dies.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given user presses Tab while in LIVE mode, when the detail panel switches to CONV mode, then the live capture timer stops and the JSONL conversation preview is displayed.
Given user presses Tab while in CONV mode, when the detail panel switches to LIVE mode, then the live capture timer starts and terminal content is displayed.
Given the detail panel is in CONV mode, when the poll cycle fires (~3s), then the conversation entries refresh from the JSONL file.
Given the selected pane has died, when the detail panel is in CONV mode, then the JSONL conversation remains visible (data persists on disk).

requirement.title: Freeze mode (Ctrl-E)
requirement.description: Ctrl-E freezes the detail panel content in either source mode. The frozen view starts from the bottom (latest content visible first). j/k scrolls 1 line (j=older/up, k=newer/down). Ctrl-U/D scrolls 10 lines. Esc unfreezes and resumes the following state.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the detail panel is in LIVE following mode, when user presses Ctrl-E, then the content is frozen (capture timer continues but UI does not update) and scroll offset is set to show the bottom of the content.
Given the detail panel is frozen, when user presses j or up-arrow, then the view scrolls up 1 line (toward older content).
Given the detail panel is frozen, when user presses k or down-arrow, then the view scrolls down 1 line (toward newer content).
Given the detail panel is frozen, when user presses Ctrl-U, then the view scrolls up 10 lines.
Given the detail panel is frozen, when user presses Ctrl-D, then the view scrolls down 10 lines.
Given the detail panel is frozen, when user presses Esc, then the view unfreezes and resumes following (auto-scroll to bottom in LIVE, refresh in CONV).
Given the detail panel is frozen in CONV mode, when the panel renders, then the conversation snapshot is static (no refresh) until Esc is pressed.

requirement.title: Auto-fallback on pane death
requirement.description: When the selected pane dies while in LIVE mode, the detail panel automatically switches to CONV mode with a dim "session ended" indicator. If already in CONV mode, no disruption occurs.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the detail panel is in LIVE mode for arcforge:1.1, when arcforge:1.1 disappears from the tmux pane list, then the detail panel switches to CONV mode and shows a dim "session ended" indicator.
Given the detail panel is in CONV mode for arcforge:1.1, when arcforge:1.1 disappears, then the JSONL conversation remains visible with "session ended" indicator. No mode switch.
Given the pane has died and detail shows CONV fallback, when user presses Tab (trying to switch to LIVE), then nothing happens — Tab is a no-op when pane is gone.

requirement.title: Mode indicator in detail header
requirement.description: The detail panel metadata header line includes a mode indicator showing the current source and state.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given LIVE following mode, when the header renders, then it shows [LIVE] after the metadata (e.g., "arcforge:1.1 · Claude 2.1.87 · 27% ctx [LIVE]").
Given CONV following mode, when the header renders, then it shows [CONV].
Given LIVE frozen mode, when the header renders, then it shows [LIVE ⏸].
Given CONV frozen mode, when the header renders, then it shows [CONV ⏸].
